title: AIDP Migrator customer configuration
description: Validated at load time by aidp_config.loader. Every customer-specific value the migration tool needs lives here; nothing is hardcoded in source.

name.description: Credential name in the AIDP Credential Store.

key.description: Field name inside the credential (multi-key credentials only).

region.description: OCI region identifier, e.g. ap-mumbai-1, us-phoenix-1.

oci_profile.description: Profile name in ~/.oci/config used for API-key auth.

default_namespace.description: Fallback OCI namespace used ONLY when a bucket is absent from oci_bucket_tenancy_mapping.json. Per-bucket namespaces come from the mapping file (authoritative).

scala_oci_config_path.description: FOR SCALA ONLY / TEMPORARY — remove after AIDP 5.0 (Scala aidputils not available until then). Absolute cluster path to an OCI API-key config file consumed by the injected %scala OciFs helper (com.oracle.bmc.auth.ConfigFileAuthenticationDetailsProvider). PySpark code paths fetch OCI signer keys from AIDP Credential Store via aidputils.secrets and do NOT read this. Set only if your notebooks use %scala + dbutils.fs.ls / entity_decrypt. Env override: OCI_CONFIG_FILE.

oci_credentials.description: OCI signer credentials fetched at cluster runtime via aidputils.secrets.get(name, key=...). Laptop-side does NOT read this block — it uses standard OCI SDK resolution (~/.oci/config with oci_profile). See scripts/oci_credential_helper.py::get_signer().

name.description: Credential name in the AIDP Credential Store.

keys.description: Maps OCI Signer field name (LHS) -> key name inside the credential (RHS). Lets you rename a key in the AIDP UI by editing only the RHS.

migrate_output.description: Base path under /Workspace for migration tool output.

export_output.description: Base path under /Workspace where dbx_export writes exported artifacts.

lib_repository_dir.description: Shared AIDP dependency repository for ALL migration artifacts (JARs AND wheels, incl. the aidp_compat wheel). Checked FIRST (by artifact name — exact version preferred, else highest) before any Databricks/proxy fetch — the PRIMARY source, not a fallback.

lib_fallback_dir.description: DEPRECATED alias for lib_repository_dir (interim post-consolidation name). Used only when lib_repository_dir is absent.

jar_fallback_dir.description: DEPRECATED alias for lib_repository_dir (pre-consolidation configs). Used only when lib_repository_dir and lib_fallback_dir are absent.

target_runtime_requirements_file.description: Optional reviewed target-cluster requirements baseline. Overrides config/target_runtime_requirements.txt; may also be set through AIDP_TARGET_RUNTIME_REQUIREMENTS_FILE.

compatibility_policy_file.description: Optional AIDP package compatibility-policy YAML. Overrides config/aidp_compatibility_policy.yaml; may also be set through AIDP_COMPATIBILITY_POLICY_FILE.

path.description: Path to the customer's S3/DBFS -> OCI bucket mapping JSON.

dbx_source.description: How the tool reaches Databricks. Exactly ONE of `host` or `proxy` is required (the CLI flags they map to are mutually exclusive).

host.description: Direct Databricks workspace URL. Requires DATABRICKS_TOKEN env var for auth. Use this when the tool can reach Databricks over the public internet.

proxy.description: OCI-side proxy host:port that fronts Databricks (network-level trust, no bearer token). Use this when direct Databricks access from OCI VNIC is not permitted. Example: <proxy-vnic-host>.compute.<vcn>.oraclevcn.com:8080

proxy_max_retries.description: Optional. Max attempts (default 10) for a GitHub-via-proxy read on a transient 429/5xx. The proxy is customer-controlled and rate-limits (nginx 429) once many developers export concurrently; raise this (up to 20) to ride out bursts. Honors the server's Retry-After (per-attempt sleep is capped so a large value can't wedge a read). Only the GitHub proxy reads use this; workspace/DBFS paths keep their own bounded retry.

secrets.description: Each secret can be a plaintext string (phase 1) or a reference to the AIDP Credential Store (later phase). Loader accepts both shapes today; credential-store resolution errors clearly until the provider is wired up.

entity_crypto_registrar.description: FQCN of the deployment's entity-crypto UDF registrar class (the JAR's registerUdf entry point). REQUIRED when entity_crypto_arn is set.

spark_config.description: Spark config baked into every new AIDP cluster this tool creates. Customer's DBX source cluster spark_conf overlays on top with auto-heal. Only spark.* keys allowed. Empty dict {} = opt out of all tool-side Spark defaults.

autoscale_config.description: Aggressive-autoscale defaults baked into every new AIDP cluster. Only spark.aidp.compute.autoscale.* keys allowed. Empty dict {} = opt out; AIDP platform autoscale defaults apply.

migration.description: Optional migration-time cluster policy. cluster_idle_timeout_minutes: the idle auto-termination (minutes) each task's cluster is temporarily raised to for the duration of that task's execution, then restored to the cluster's original value in a per-task finally (success or failure). Prevents mid-run idle-termination during long think/setup gaps without permanently raising the cluster's cost profile. Best-effort: a failed bump/restore is reported loudly, never fails the migration. Absent = default 30; only raises a cluster whose current timeout is BELOW this value.

llm.description: LLM provider/model for the migration engine — swap the model from YAML within the validated Opus-5 family. OPTIONAL at the schema level so non-migrator/partial configs still validate; the migrator REQUIRES it and fails loudly (llm_config.configure) if absent. thinking (adaptive) and output budget (16000) are FIXED internal constants, NOT config knobs — on the Opus-5 family 'thinking: off' can't disable adaptive thinking and max_tokens is not a true per-request cap, so they are not exposed. See scripts/llm_config.py.

provider.description: Only 'anthropic' is dispatched today; adding a provider is a code+schema change (adapter), not a YAML-only swap.

model.description: Restricted to the validated Opus-5 family; switching between them is a YAML-only edit. Adding a model / re-adding thinking or max_tokens is a code+schema+test change. See scripts/llm_config.py.

redirect.description: Execution-only write sandbox and direct Python dbutils.fs output-consumer mapping. Saved paths and cleanup slash semantics are retained. Direct put/mkdirs/copy destinations are redirected. Untracked OCI cleanup/move and known OCI directory copy/move fail REDIRECT_REFUSED without model repair, even if customer code catches the exception. Full bucket@namespace and configured table_prefix define sandbox identity. Dynamic spark.sql DML, writer aliases, writeStream, arbitrary SDK calls and ancestor-directory reads are outside this mapping. Optional section; if absent, disabled. If present, ALL three fields are required.

customizations.description: Optional. Customer customization pack for notebooks whose AIDP conversion cannot be produced by generic rules or the LLM (injected business data, new capabilities, SDK swaps). `path` points at a pack directory containing overrides.yaml + notebooks/. Absent = no customizations.

assert_present.description: Per-customer 'must be set' assertions. Dotted paths of OPTIONAL config fields that MUST be present and non-empty for THIS customer's deployment. Loader errors at startup if any listed field resolves to absent / empty. Distinct from schema-level `required` (which is tool-wide: fields every customer needs). Use this list to opt-in to fail-loud behavior for optional features your setup depends on (e.g. MLflow, redirect sandbox).
